summary: Sony's Play/Create/Share platform series; online community servers are now shut down, so best-version choices emphasize offline/story preservation, local creation, and highest-fidelity playable builds.

entries.title: LittleBigPlanet

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable; online services are closed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS3 HD output / RPCS3 scaling where compatible

primary.why: The first LittleBigPlanet is PS3-only; emulation or original PS3 hardware is the only route, but official online sharing is no longer available.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 release through RPCS3 if compatible or on PS3 hardware; treat it as an offline/story and local-create experience because official servers are closed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern port documented; online UGC is unavailable.

emulation.notes: Use high internal resolution; use hardware for original handheld feel.

primary.why: The PSP LittleBigPlanet is a distinct handheld entry; PPSSPP gives the best practical fidelity for the original handheld release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP release through PPSSPP at high internal resolution, or on PSP/Vita hardware for original controls; online sharing is no longer available.

emulation.notes: Requires PlayStation Move and PlayStation Eye; minimum two-player setup is part of the design.

primary.why: Prehistoric Moves is a Move-focused co-op spin-off and requires the Move/PlayStation Eye setup, so original PS3 hardware is the most complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware with PlayStation Move, PlayStation Eye, and at least one DualShock player; emulation is archival only because the motion setup is core to play.

entries.title: LittleBigPlanet 2

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable; online services are closed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS3 HD output / RPCS3 scaling where compatible

primary.why: LittleBigPlanet 2 is PS3-only and can play/edit many first-game levels locally, but official online services are closed.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 release through RPCS3 if compatible or on PS3 hardware; use it for story, local creation, and already-preserved local content only.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern port documented; servers closed.

entries.title: LittleBigPlanet PS Vita

emulation.notes: Vita-specific input makes hardware the safest route.

primary.why: LittleBigPlanet PS Vita is built for Vita-specific touch/camera features and has no modern port documented, making original Vita hardware the most complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PlayStation Vita hardware; online community servers are closed, so focus on story and local creation.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern port documented; online UGC unavailable.

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PS3 HD output / RPCS3 scaling where compatible

primary.why: Karting is a PS3-only spin-off with no modern port documented; RPCS3 gives the best practical image quality for the offline content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 release through RPCS3 if compatible or on PS3 hardware; online sharing/server features should be considered unavailable.

primary.why: LittleBigPlanet Hub was announced as a free PSN download but never received a final public release, so no definitive playable release can be assigned.
primary.how_to_play: Do not assign a normal play route; only unofficial archival beta builds are documented, and they should not be treated as a shipped game.

entries.title: Run Sackboy! Run!

emulation.notes: Use owned installs; support ended in 2018.

primary.why: Run Sackboy! Run! released on mobile and Vita; the Vita version is the most stable PlayStation-native preservation route if still owned.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Vita release if owned, or the mobile versions if still available; note that further support was announced as shut down in 2018.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile/live support ended; no modern remaster documented.

entries.title: LittleBigPlanet 3
entries.definitive_edition: PlayStation 4 release if already owned or on disc

emulation.emulator: None for PS4; RPCS3 for PS3 fallback
emulation.notes: Use owned disc/digital PS4 copy; online UGC is unavailable.

primary.why: The PS4 release has the highest official console fidelity and preserves the offline story/create toolset, but online services are closed and the digital release was delisted.
primary.how_to_play: Play a disc or already-owned digital PS4 copy on PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility; expect offline/local play only because online services are no longer available.

entries.remaster_caveats: PS4 servers are offline indefinitely and the digital game/DLC were removed from sale on October 31, 2024.

entries.title: Sackboy: A Big Adventure

primary.why: The PC version is the highest-fidelity route for Sackboy's 3D platforming spin-off, with the PS5 version as the best console option.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release on a capable PC; use PS5 if you prefer console/DualSense integration.

entries.remaster_caveats: This spin-off does not include the traditional LittleBigPlanet create/share toolset.

entries.title: Ultimate Sackboy

emulation.notes: Use native mobile platforms if available.

primary.why: Ultimate Sackboy is a mobile runner released for iOS and Android; there is no console or PC version documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play the mobile release from the App Store or Google Play if available in your region; treat availability as store/account dependent.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile spin-off, not a traditional create/share LittleBigPlanet game.
